qt*.reason: Qt modules are offered as LGPL-3.0, GPL-2.0/3.0 or commercial; the vcpkg port has no license field. We use the LGPL-3.0 option, dynamically linked.

stb.reason: stb headers are dual-licensed MIT / public domain (Unlicense).

cpp-base64.reason: Copyright text in the package is the zlib license wording.

double-conversion.reason: Google double-conversion uses the 3-clause BSD license.

libb2.reason: BLAKE2 reference code: choose any of CC0-1.0, OpenSSL or Apache-2.0 (we take CC0-1.0).

libiconv.reason: GNU libiconv library part (the iconv tool is GPL, not built here).

opengl-registry.reason: Khronos registry headers carry MIT or Apache-2.0 per file.

vcpkg-make.reason: vcpkg helper scripts, MIT (build tool only).

egl.reason: Only checks for the system's EGL; no code is shipped.

opengl.reason: Only links the system's OpenGL; no code is shipped.

pthread.reason: Empty package that links the system's pthread.

purposes.opencascade: Precise B-Rep geometry kernel (booleans, fillets, STEP)
purposes.minizip-ng: ZIP container of the .fission file format
